source.credit: Food Wise Learn at Home Print Materials, Rutgers University Cooperative Extension

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Grease two 8x4x2 inch loaf pans.
Toast 1/2 cup of chopped walnuts in an ungreased skillet on medium-low heat.
Stir the walnuts for 5 minutes, until brown and nutty.
steps.spoken: Stir for 5 to seven minutes, until the walnuts are brown and smell nutty.

steps.instruction: Set the walnuts aside to cool.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of applesauce, 1 egg and 1 cup of sugar in a large bowl.
Mix in 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Mix 2 cups of flour and 2 teaspoons of baking soda in a smaller bowl.
Mix 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon and 1/2 teaspoon of nutmeg into the flour.
Pour the flour mixture into the applesauce mixture.
Stir in 1 cup of raisins and the cooled walnuts.
Pour half of the batter into each greased pan.
Bake for 45 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 45 to fifty-five minutes.

steps.instruction: Take the cakes out of the oven and cool them for 10 minutes.
Remove the cakes from the pans to finish cooling.
steps.spoken: Remove the cakes from the pans to finish cooling. For the best taste, let them cool a few hours before serving.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Kids a Cookin’, Kansas Family Nutrition Program

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Cream 1/2 cup of shortening and 3/4 cup of sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer.
Add 2 large eggs and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and mix well.
Mix 1 1/2 cups of flour and 1 teaspoon of baking powder in a medium bowl.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of baking soda and 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Add the flour mixture and 1 cup of mashed banana to the creamed mixture and mix well.
Line a muffin tin with paper baking cups, or coat it with cooking spray.
Fill the muffin cups 2/3 full of batter.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 to twenty-two minutes, until golden brown.

steps.instruction: Remove the cupcakes from the tin and place them on a rack to cool.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service - Sawyer County and the Lac Courte Oreilles Tribe

ingredients.name: fat-free milk, only if adding carrots, raisins or walnuts

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Line a muffin tin with paper cups, or grease the bottom with cooking spray.
Mix 1/4 cup of vegetable oil and 1 cup of sugar with an electric mixer or by hand.
Add 1 egg and 1 1/4 cups of unsweetened applesauce, mixing well.
Blend in 1 1/2 teaspoons cinnamon, 1 teaspoon baking soda and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Blend in 1 cup of all-purpose flour and 1 cup of whole wheat flour.
Add carrots, raisins or walnuts and 1/2 cup of milk, if using.
steps.spoken: If you like, add carrots, raisins or walnuts. If you add any of these, also add 1/2 cup of fat-free milk and mix.

steps.instruction: Fill the muffin tin cups 2/3 full.
Bake for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 15 to eighteen minutes.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Food Hero, Oregon State University Cooperative Extension Service

ingredients.name: seasoning, try a mixture of chili powder, garlic powder, ground cumin and pepper
cooked chicken, shredded or chopped (or tofu, or a combination)
beans, canned or cooked, drained, any type

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Wash the 4 bell peppers.
Remove the seeds from the peppers.
Cut the peppers into bite-sized pieces.
Arrange the pieces close together in a single layer on a large foil-lined baking sheet.
Mix 1 cup of salsa and 2 teaspoons of seasoning in a medium bowl.
Mix in 1 cup of cooked chicken and 1 cup of drained beans.
steps.spoken: Mix in 1 cup of cooked chicken, or tofu, or a mix of both, and 1 cup of drained beans.

steps.instruction: Spoon the mixture evenly over the pepper pieces.
Top with 3/4 cup of shredded cheddar cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the peppers are heated through and the cheese is melted.

source.credit: Kids a Cookin’, Kansas Family Nutrition Program and the USDA Food Stamp Nutrition Education Program, Recipe by Lynn Walters and Jane Stacey

steps.instruction: Drain the juice from 1 can of black beans.
Mash the drained beans in a bowl until they are no longer whole.
steps.spoken: Mash the drained beans with a potato masher until they are no longer whole, then set them aside.

steps.instruction: Chop 1/2 medium onion into 1/4-inch pieces.
Peel and finely mince 2 cloves of garlic.
Heat 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion.
steps.spoken: Add the onion and sauté for 1 to two minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in the garlic and 1/2 teaspoon of ground cumin.
steps.spoken: Stir in the garlic and the cumin, and cook for 30 seconds more.

steps.instruction: Stir in the mashed beans and the second can of beans, with its juice.
When the beans begin to boil, reduce the heat to low.
Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of salt, if using, and 1/4 teaspoon of dried oregano.
Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes.

source.name: based.cooking
source.credit: based.cooking contributor Kyle Johnson and Sabina Mortensen

ingredients.name: butter, plus more for the dish

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Butter a deep baking dish.
Peel and thinly slice 1 1/3 pounds of potatoes.
Grate 9 ounces of cheddar cheese.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a pot.
Slowly add 2 tablespoons of flour, stirring all the time.
Cook for 2 minutes, until bubbly.
steps.spoken: Cook for 2 minutes, or until it is bubbly.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat.
Slowly add 1 1/4 cups of milk, stirring all the time.
Add 3/4 of the cheese to the sauce.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Put a thin layer of potatoes in the baking dish.
Add a layer of cheese sauce.
Add a layer of bacon.
Repeat the layers until there are no more potatoes or sauce.
Sprinkle the remaining 1/4 of the cheese on top.
Bake for 45 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 45 minutes. If it starts to brown too much, cover it with foil.

steps.instruction: Pat 8 chicken thighs dry, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a heavy, deep pan on high heat.
Lay the thighs skin side down in the pan.
steps.spoken: Lay the chicken thighs skin side down in the pan and brown them for 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Flip the thighs and brown them for 5 more minutes.
Move the browned thighs to a plate and set them aside.
Add 2 medium chopped onions to the pan and cook until golden.
Add 1 tablespoon of powdered garlic and 3 tablespoons of tomato paste.
steps.spoken: Add 1 tablespoon of powdered garlic and 3 tablespoons of tomato paste. Stir for 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1/4 cup of paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add 2 cups of chicken or beef broth and let it heat.
Lower the heat to medium-low and put the thighs back in the pan.
Cover the pan and simmer for 45 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pan and simmer for 45 to sixty minutes.

steps.instruction: Check the chicken is tender with a fork, then season to taste.
steps.spoken: Check that the chicken is tender with a fork, and that a thermometer reads 165 °F in the thickest part. Then add salt and pepper to taste.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Mix 1/2 cup coconut milk, 1 tablespoon soy sauce and 1 tablespoon sesame oil.
Add 1 tablespoon each of pepper flakes, minced ginger and black pepper.
Marinate the 5 cod fillets in the mixture for 15 minutes.
Place the fillets on a baking pan greased with cooking oil.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the fish is flaky.
Top with 1 tablespoon each of toasted coconut flakes and mint.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add 1 sliced onion, 2 cloves of sliced garlic and 1 inch of sliced ginger.
steps.spoken: Add the sliced onion, the sliced garlic and the sliced ginger. Fry for 15 minutes, until the onion is soft.

steps.instruction: Add 2 tablespoons of curry powder and 1/2 teaspoon of turmeric.
Add 1 tablespoon of malt vinegar and 1 star anise.
steps.spoken: Add the malt vinegar and the star anise. Fry for 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Pour in 1 cup of chicken stock.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring.
Take out the star anise.
Add 1 tablespoon of cornstarch and 2 tablespoons of water.
steps.spoken: Add the cornstarch and the water. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring.

steps.instruction: Blend the sauce until smooth.
If you like, stir in some lemon juice.

ingredients.name: blended blueberries, or any mix-in of your choice

steps.instruction: Beat 1 can of condensed milk with a mixer for 2 minutes, until smooth.
Set the condensed milk aside.
In a separate bowl, whip 2 cups of heavy cream for 4 minutes.
steps.spoken: In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream for about 4 minutes, until it is thick and stiff peaks form.

steps.instruction: Gently fold the condensed milk into the whipped cream.
Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract and 2 handfuls of blended blueberries.
Mix by hand until just combined.
Move the mixture to a clean container that holds about 35 ounces.
Spread it evenly and press lightly to remove air pockets.
Shake the container gently from side to side to level the top.
Cover with plastic wrap, then close with a lid.
Freeze for 5 hours, until firm.
steps.spoken: Freeze for 5 to six hours, until firm.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Spread 1/4 cup of tomato sauce on the pizza shell.
Top the sauce with half of the shredded cheese.
Add 1/2 cup of chicken breast and 1 diced red pepper on top in any design.
steps.spoken: Add 1/2 cup of cubed cooked chicken and 1 diced red pepper on top, in whatever design you want. Have fun with it.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top.
Bake for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 10 to twelve minutes.

ingredients.name: evaporated milk, optional for a creamy version

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a pan.
Saute 1 chopped onion and 3 cloves of minced garlic until fragrant.
Add 1 pound of chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Pour in 2 tablespoons of fish sauce and stir for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of pineapple juice and simmer 15 minutes, until the chicken is tender.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of pineapple juice and simmer for 15 to twenty minutes, until the chicken is tender.

steps.instruction: Add 2 chopped carrots and 1 cup of pineapple chunks.
Keep cooking until the vegetables soften.
Pour in 1 cup of evaporated milk to make it creamy, if you like.
Add 1 sliced red bell pepper.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for 3 more minutes, then serve hot.
steps.spoken: Simmer for another 3 to five minutes, then serve hot.

steps.instruction: Peel 2 pounds of potatoes.
Cut the potatoes into small pieces.
steps.spoken: Cut the potatoes into small pieces. The smaller they are, the faster they cook.

steps.instruction: Put the potatoes in a pot and cover them with water.
Bring to a boil and cook until the potatoes are soft.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with a fork.
Warm 7/8 cup of milk in a pan, but do not let it boil.
Still on the heat, add 1 tablespoon of butter and the mashed potatoes.
Add grated cheese, if you like, and stir until smooth.
Keep stirring on the heat until it is as thick as you like.
Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a pot with a steamer basket.
Add 1 pound of broccoli florets to the basket and cover the pot.
Toss the broccoli with 1 tablespoon of butter and a pinch of salt.
